subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “The platform added clearer descriptions of time, skills, and responsibility.”?
options: The students learned that planning needs both simulation and observation.
Students learned that free expression and community standards often need balance.
Students learned that volunteering is not only showing up.
A student volunteering there learned that kindness needs organization.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「The students learned that planning needs both simulation and observation.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Students learned that free expression and community standards often need balance.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The platform added clearer descriptions of time, skills, and responsibility. Students learned that volunteering is not only showing up.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「A student volunteering there learned that kindness needs organization.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The platform added clearer descriptions of time, skills, and responsibility. Students learned that volunteering is not only showing up.」，答案為「Students learned that volunteering is not only showing up.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Students learned that volunteering is not only showing up.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
